card.title: FUKUOKA REGIMENT
card.text: Destruction: The enemy gains an extra kredit slot.
card.flavorText: The 246th Infantry Regiment (Fukuoka) was part of the 112th Division of the Imperial Japanese Army. The division was formed in July 1944 in Korea and later stationed in the Jiandao area of Manchuria. When the Soviet Union invaded Manchuria on August 9th, 1945, the division engaged in heavy defensive battles against Soviet forces, and despite being only 35% combat effective, the division repelled several Soviet attacks, including an armored assault near Michiang on August 11th and another near Unggidong on August 15th. However, following Japan's surrender, the division was ordered to surrender and most of its soldiers were subsequently taken prisoner by the Soviet Red Army.
